item.title: Christa & Tonyo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: NTRMAN
  • 発売日: 2025-05-19
  • スコア: 6.17/10 (56 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Christa & Tonyo
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Somewhere in Southeast Asia, a couple’s life takes an unexpected turn after a workplace accident leaves the husband temporarily disabled. With no income and mounting expenses, their financial burden slowly becomes too heavy to bear. Desperate, the wife is convinced by her closest friend to try “online dating” —not in search of love, but to find a “sugar daddy” who can support both her and her husband, at least for now.

item.title: Arrival of the Goddess
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: NTRMAN
  • 発売日: 2024-07-22
  • スコア: 7.2/10 (145 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Arrival of the Goddess
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

When Dr.Ben Johnson and his wife Dr.Claire heard about the mysterious Moonflower and its amazing healing properties, they wasted no time heading to an island in the middle of the Pacific to hunt for the fabled plant.

What they didn’t expect to find there was the Aimumu, an ancestral tribe who had been watching over the island for centuries and guarded the secrets of the Moonflower from the hands of outsiders. To complete his ambitious research and make a name for himself in the halls of science, Dr Ben will need to earn the tribe’s trust.

  • 日本語名: The Queen who adopted a Goblin
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

The Kingdom of Golden Kine has just won a great battle against a great horde of goblins. As the king proudly surveyed the aftermath of the battlefield with his beloved, they find a lone goblin survivor within one of the destroyed catapults. The Queen takes an interest in him and decides to adopt him in order to discover and learn how humans and goblins could peacefully co-exist. Thus her “discovery” begins and her son will be the witness..​.
